satisfactory.oewn-01128566-s.tone: Meets the requirement and says no more - approval with the warmth taken out.

great.oewn-01127641-s.tone: Everyday enthusiasm - real approval, plainly said.

groovy.oewn-01127641-s.tone: Period slang - approval with a dated, deliberately retro ring.

dense.oewn-00442596-s.tone: Mild, and it can be jokey - failing to grasp what is plain.

plunder.oewn-02350284-v.tone: Systematic, large-scale robbery - theft on the scale of armies.

civilized.oewn-01954376-s.tone: Sets a bar and implies others fall below it - praise with a hierarchy inside it.

civilised.oewn-01954376-s.tone: The British spelling; the same compliment with the same hierarchy inside it.

big.oewn-01115129-s.tone: Praise with a shrug - 'big of you' can be sincere or sarcastic.

casual.oewn-00313032-s.tone: In this sense, attention that was never offered - the ease is the fault.

superficial.oewn-00313032-s.tone: Cuts twice - shallow work, with a shallow person implied behind it.

gracious.oewn-00644482-s.tone: The warmest in the family - courtesy extended when it need not have been.

laud.oewn-00862284-v.tone: Ceremonial - it lifts the praise onto a formal, liturgical register.

swash.oewn-00884747-v.tone: Archaic - it suggests noise and swagger rather than claims.

esurient.oewn-00010745-s.tone: Literary and dry - hunger stated as if from a distance.

crushed.oewn-01899370-s.tone: The heaviest word in the family, and always about defeat rather than character.

meek.oewn-01899577-s.tone: Mildness that shades into submission - the virtue and the weakness share the word.

grubby.oewn-00422169-s.tone: Mild enough to be affectionate - dirt of the kind a child comes home in.

hard-core.oewn-00965214-s.tone: Intensity without direction - the loyalty is total, whatever it is to.

cunning.oewn-00149346-s.tone: Skill in deceiving, and the skill is half admired - the disapproval is real but not total.

foxy.oewn-00149346-s.tone: The animal metaphor - deceit with the fox's reputation for it.

guileful.oewn-00149346-s.tone: Formal - the deceiving is deliberate and rather cold.

knavish.oewn-00149346-s.tone: Names the person a knave - archaic, with a costume-drama ring.

pitiless.oewn-01511765-s.tone: Final and total - it fits weather and landscape as well as people, and is just as cold either way.

simple.oewn-02279797-s.tone: Dangerous - the compliment sits next to an insult, and the word does not say which it means.

bossy.oewn-00791150-s.tone: The mildest in the family - it belittles the manner rather than condemning the power.

high-class.oewn-00853840-s.tone: Pretension built in - it announces a rank rather than showing one.

rumpled.oewn-02433993-s.tone: The gentlest word in the family - rumpled clothes are forgiven, and sometimes liked.

disorderly.oewn-02434302-s.tone: Disorder as a fault - the word has the ring of an offence.

punk.oewn-02354508-s.tone: Dated slang for poor quality - shabby, and slightly comic for being so dated.

scoured.oewn-02592502-s.tone: Worn by water or wind - the surface stripped rather than damaged.

dandyish.oewn-00853318-s.tone: Vanity of dress as a character trait - the dandy made an adjective.
